title: Migration - export & import

blocks.intro: Every endpoint in this service, with the exact HTTP verbs it accepts. Where an endpoint accepts more than one verb they are all listed.
rows: Start an export job for named objects

200 on submission. Empty objects[] -> 400. TWO DISTINCT 400s worth telling apart, live 2026-07-26: MigrationSvc_041 'No asset selected for export operation' means the body shape was ACCEPTED but the named object contributes no exportable asset (e.g. an empty Project) - it is a CONTENT verdict, not a shape error; V3API_007 'Bad Request' means the body shape itself is wrong. objects[] takes OBJECTS ({"id": "..."}), never bare id strings, and adding a 'type' key produces V3API_007. rejected: GET 405; untested: PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

200 on a genuine package. THE TRAP IS CONTENT-TYPE, verified live 2026-07-26 across four encodings on one org: application/json -> 404 MigrationSvc_025 'Import request with identifier [package] doesnt exist' (reads as a DEAD ROUTE and is not - the service is parsing 'package' as an importId); application/zip -> 415; application/octet-stream -> 415; multipart/form-data -> 400 MigrationSvc_030 'Invalid import package' = the handler parsed the upload and rejected the CONTENT. So MigrationSvc_030 is the SUCCESS signal for route discovery and only means the zip was hand-built. Send multipart/form-data with a genuine export zip. untested: GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.
404 No static resource core/v3/import  —  rejected: POST 404; untested: GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE

415 Unsupported Media Type on application/json, and 404 MigrationSvc_025 'Import request with identifier [upload] doesnt exist' - i.e. the segment after /import/ is read as an importId, so this is not a separate upload route. The real path is /public/core/v3/import/package with multipart/form-data. rejected: POST; untested: GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

blocks.label: MCP coverage for this service:
blocks.text: No MCP server covers this service. Everything here is REST-only.

notes.label: A 404 that names your path segment is not a dead route.
notes.text: MigrationSvc_025 'Import request with identifier [X] doesnt exist' means the service read X as an importId and looked it up. That is a live handler answering a lookup, not a missing route - and because it is a 404 it is very easy to file under Law 3 as 'wrong path' and walk away. Before concluding a write route is absent, vary the CONTENT-TYPE as well as the path: on this endpoint json gives 404, zip and octet-stream give 415, and only multipart reaches the validator.

notes.label: MigrationSvc_041 vs V3API_007 - a content verdict is not a shape error.
notes.text: On /v3/export, MigrationSvc_041 'No asset selected' means your body parsed fine and the target simply holds nothing exportable; V3API_007 means the body shape is wrong. Reading 041 as a shape error sends you sweeping body variants against an endpoint that already accepted your request - the fix is to pick a different object, not a different body.

open_questions: Whether the multipart field name matters. 'package' was used and reached MigrationSvc_030; no other field name was tried, so a cleaner 200 path may exist.
